C0056.title: Lyu’s Fake Return Fraud of Over 4 Million Yuan Against Kans
C0056.summary: Between December 2023 and March 2024, Lyu rented multiple accounts to place orders on the Kans flagship store on Douyin, then used fake logistics tracking numbers to simulate returns for over 10,000 orders. After obtaining refunds, Lyu resold the unreturned cosmetics, illicitly profiting over 4 million yuan. The court convicted Lyu of fraud and sentenced him to 6 years in prison.
